text:
Nina Patel: Heads-up 10-day paid plan for May webinar. KPI: 900 registrants, target CPL $12, total budget $11,000. Need channel plan + creative cadence.
Omar Singh: Proposal: week 1 blended search + prospecting social to build top funnel, week 2 shift heavier to retarget + search exact match. Keeps CPA stable.
June Park: Agree. For search: start with high-intent branded + non-branded bottom-funnel keywords. Add sitelinks to agenda + speakers.
Tess O'Neill: Retarget audiences: 3d video viewers, 14d site visitors, 90d past webinar opens. Bid tiers: 3d = +25%, 14d = baseline, 90d = -15%.
Nina Patel: Creative rotation: 4 variations, swap every 72 hours. Variants: speaker-focus, problem-first, social-proof (testimonial), urgency. June will upload assets by Monday noon.
June Park: Upload naming: `may_web_headA_v1.png`, `may_web_testimonial_v2.mp4`. Also prepping a 6s square GIF for socials.
Omar Singh: Social prospecting test: split test two audiences (SaaS PMs vs ML Engs). Budget for social test $1k total. KPI for social = registration rate, not just CTR.
Tess O'Neill: Landing page requirements: hidden fields `utm_medium=cpc`, `utm_campaign=may_webinar_2026`, capture `ad_id` and `creative_id`. Add a lightweight engagement pixel for video plays.
Nina Patel: UTM example to paste into campaigns: `?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=may_webinar_2026&utm_content={adid}`
June Park: Also add fallback headline for low-engagement ads: "Join product leaders: free 45-min demo + Q&A".
Omar Singh: Budget allocation: Search $5k, Retarget $3.5k, Social prospecting $1k, Experiment buffer $0.5k, Ops buffer $1k for quick boosts.
Tess O'Neill: Bidding: start with max CPC $4 on search, enable enhanced CPC, set initial target CPA $12. Enable dayparting 8am-8pm ET.
Nina Patel: Lead flow: Ads -> LP -> Intercom flow -> Salesforce campaign `MayWebinar_Paid2026`. Can we confirm field mapping and webhook? @Omar
Omar Singh: Confirmed fields: `email, first_name, last_name, utm_campaign, ad_group, keyword, ad_id`. Will map to `MayWebinar_Paid2026`.
ads-bot: Asset ingestion started for `may_web_headA_v1.png`, estimated 9 minutes.
June Park: Naming convention for reporting: `paid/webinar/may2026/{channel}/{audience_segment}` 1ine with existing taxonomy but callout for experiments with `-exp`.
Nina Patel: Reporting cadence: daily summary in #marketing-ads with spend, CPL, conv rate, top 5 keywords, low-perf creatives listed. Weekly deep-dive postmortem after campaign.
Omar Singh: I'll configure dashboard and set alert: CPL > $18 or spend rate > 110% of burn plan triggers a paging message.
Tess O'Neill: Exclusions: exclude `registrants_60d` and `converted_leads_90d` from retarget sets. We'll run a re-engagement drip for those groups later.
June Park: Quick QA note 1t the form validation, ensure `ad_id` persists in confirmation emails so sales sees source.
Nina Patel: Final: creative approvals due Tue 11am so we can QA Wed 10am and launch Thu 09:00 PT. Everyone good?
Omar Singh: Good. Adding `ad_id` to Intercom payload as requested.
Tess O'Neill: I'll prep audience lists and share exported counts by EOD.
June Park: I'll upload the assets and the creative spec doc to Drive, link in the thread once done.
Nina Patel: Thanks all 1action list: June upload assets + creative doc, Omar dashboard + SF mapping, Tess audience exports + retarget setup. Reconvene Sat 9am PT for first 48h pulse. :rocket:
ads-bot: Campaigns queued: `paid/webinar/may2026/google/search`, `paid/webinar/may2026/meta/prospecting-exp`, `paid/webinar/may2026/google/retarget` scheduled for 2026-05-07 09:00:00 PT."
